A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the K–T event was marked by a major disruption of the terrestrial ecosystem.
the K–T impact event was the cause of the abrupt extinction of pollen taxa and the subsequent replacement of Cretaceous floras by Tertiary floras.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the K–T plant extinction was global, not local.
the K–T impact event had a significant effect on the plant community of western North America, causing extinctions of many plant species.
the plant fossil record of the K–T event is a record of extinctions and not a record of survival.
